breaking_news.headline: Despite the controversy, data centers could be attractive to struggling rural towns
breaking_news.summary: There's lots of debate over data centers and where they should be located. In a struggling rural town data center development can look a lot more attractive.

breaking_news.headline: How the beverage aisle got so wild
breaking_news.summary: Planet Money traced many new beverage flavors to one laboratory that serves dozens of companies to see how new flavors are created and why we're seeing such an explosion of options right now.

breaking_news.headline: Fired OpenAI employees question the company's commitment to safety
breaking_news.summary: The three fired workers say OpenAI punished them for being outspoken about safety. The company disputes the claims and says they were fired over mishandling sensitive information.

breaking_news.headline: Kalshi taps former FBI agent to fight against money laundering
breaking_news.summary: The prediction market company says it wants to prevent its platform from being abused by criminals. The company is facing mounting pressure over market manipulation and insider trading on the site.

breaking_news.headline: It's taking longer to find a new job after losing one
breaking_news.summary: People who lose their jobs in this economy are taking longer to find new work. Nearly four in ten people exhaust their unemployment benefits before they land a new job.

breaking_news.headline: Justice Department investigates TV networks, citing possible anti-trust violations
breaking_news.summary: The move escalates Trump's fight with the press amid court battle over barring CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House.

breaking_news.headline: 2 Americans win Nobel Prize in economics for work on boom-bust cycles
breaking_news.summary: Two Americans have won the Nobel Prize in economics for their work on how to smooth boom-and-bust cycles to limit unemployment and inflation.

breaking_news.headline: Farmers say they'll take the relief of Trump's EO — but they're still hurting
breaking_news.summary: President Trump says his Monday executive order temporarily suspending federal taxes on diesel will be a big relief for farmers. Some farmers call it a campaign ploy with marginal impact.

breaking_news.headline: Immigration agents search congresswoman Ilhan Omar's home
breaking_news.summary: Omar, an outspoken Trump critic, said the search was "an attempt to target political enemies" and she "will not be silenced".

breaking_news.headline: South Africa's deputy police chief resigns after being charged with sexual offences
breaking_news.summary: Shadrack Sibiya had denied grooming a 16-year-old and raping an 18-year-old.

breaking_news.headline: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies aged 34
breaking_news.summary: Mitte, who lived with cerebral palsy, starred as Walter White Jr in the Emmy-winning drama series.

breaking_news.headline: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
breaking_news.summary: It comes after the armed group hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people, in a significant escalation.

breaking_news.headline: Documents falsified to evade tax on Abramovich's wealth, BBC finds
breaking_news.summary: Backdated paperwork also made the Russian oligarch’s yachts and mansions disappear from accounts, investigation finds.

breaking_news.headline: Why Moscow is staying tight-lipped on Trump's energy ceasefire
breaking_news.summary: While Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky suggests he would sign up to a ceasefire on energy infrastructure, Russia has said little.

breaking_news.headline: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
breaking_news.summary: Despite the US president announcing energy infrastructure would not be targeted strikes have continued, Ukraine says.

breaking_news.headline: Roofing scammers con homeowners out of thousands of pounds
breaking_news.summary: One in 10 scams reported to Citizens Advice relate to fraudsters charging for work not done, or done badly.

breaking_news.headline: AI minister warns 'likely' UK's cyber defences will be breached
breaking_news.summary: Kanishka Narayan said the government will use advanced AI to strengthen the UK against cyber attacks.

breaking_news.headline: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack
breaking_news.summary: Hundreds of stores were targeted by the overnight hack, which spoiled fresh and frozen food estimated to be worth millions of euros.

breaking_news.headline: How to avoid getting stung if you miss credit card payments
breaking_news.summary: People are increasingly falling behind on credit card repayments, so here's the best way to get debt advice.

breaking_news.headline: Healey faces £35bn Budget challenge to meet spending pledges, says think tank
breaking_news.summary: The Institute for Fiscal Studies says the government will need a "top-up" of billions of pounds if it wants to meet its spending plans.
